selectedProcedure.NEW_attack: Tremor Slam is exactly one commanded melee spell attack, reach5feet measured from actual body; use the current original casting-owner source-class attack and DC. After the actual hit a Large-or-smaller recipient separately makes STR save versus that source DC; failure applies Prone unless genuine Prone/knockdown immunity prevents it. A miss grants no save or knockdown. Zero actual damage does not erase a hit. No area tremor, extra attacks, forced displacement or grounding is added; actual hover/support/Falling follow their own source.
selectedProcedure.NEW_command_and_birth: Use the supplied owner-wide one BonusAction command and one damaging/control companion Action per numbered round across actual acquired assets. Issue on the owner regular turn within60feet with actual command perception and LoE; execute in attached phase only after that whole turn, revalidating body/target/range. An extra turn creates no new command/offense allowance. Explicit NEW Greater-Pet birth rule: it may not execute damaging/control offense in its formation numbered round; formation supplies no free attack or command. Ordinary defensive movement/Dodge remains possible when capable, unlike the separately source-specific Auto-Raise newborn total-action prohibition. A later valid offensive command spends the shared offense even on a miss. Without a command defensive movement and Dodge only. A basic permitted nondamaging task spends the command but does not infer tools/professional work/automatic Help.

operational.targets: One unoccupied space you perceive within range and line of effect.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; preserve the virtual phase through initiative changes, absence, death and planar travel. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application, retaining that absolute deadline when entering initiative. An already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier at concentration end or pet 0 HP.
operational.resolution: No initial roll. Its commanded offensive Action makes one melee spell attack using your actual casting-class spell attack bonus, reach 5 feet. A hit deals 1d10 bludgeoning, with no ability damage modifier. After that hit, a Large-or-smaller target makes a Strength save against your spell DC; failure makes it Prone. A successful save prevents only knockdown. Ordinary attack, critical and defense rules apply.
operational.effect: Summon one Medium earth elemental companion: AC 17, HP 30, walking Speed30, body mass 300 pounds, saves equal to owner PB, other checks +0, ordinary sight/hearing. It understands your spoken commands but has no speaking language or telepathy. It acts immediately after you. Your Bonus Action, while within 60 feet and able to convey a perceived command, permits movement plus its attack or one basic legal nondamaging Action. Without a command it may move defensively and Dodge. The attack consumes the owner-wide one offensive companion Action for that numbered round even on a miss; it shares the owner-wide command allowance.
operational.scaling: Only the printed owner PB saves and actual class spell attack/DC change with the caster. AC 17, HP 30, 1d10 damage and one attack remain fixed; no standard S-dice progression.
operational.limitations: Huge/Gargantuan targets take damage normally but are ineligible for this knockdown unless an exact rule overrides that size gate. Prone immunity or an exact immunity expressly covering knockdown prevents Prone; immunity only to positional push/pull does not itself grant Prone immunity. Damage reduced to 0 does not erase a resolved hit or its separate save. Knockdown supplies no displacement, collision damage, stun or whole-Action denial; ordinary support/Falling and stand-up rules apply. One Earth Pet per caster; it vanishes at 0 HP or concentration end. No burrow, tremorsense, earth glide, resistance, immunity, hands/tool use, cargo capacity, free Help advantage, autonomous opportunity attack, spellcasting, loot, corpse or resource/death trigger. Its printed mass is real for carrying and condition accounting but cannot be harvested as permanent stone. A successful replacement has its own endpoint; stale cleanup cannot end the new application. A countered cast creates no replacement, although its concentration transition has already occurred. Actual class access, rank, preparation, V/S/F components, casting costs, Dissonance/Refrain, class hooks, concentration transitions and counter windows follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Costs and beginning hooks commit before interruption, with no refunds or restoration of prior concentration. Direct target selection and local creation require the printed line of effect; expressly remote teleport destinations use their own printed rules. No generic upcast or unstated scaling.
